policy.identity: Attest the fixed maximum precision ceiling (1), independent of ambient lane configuration; execution may select stricter zero.
policy.input: Require positive actual debit, never greater than requested, and shortfall at most the selected tolerance.
policy.strictOutput: Independently observed positive receipt differs from the quote by at most the precision ceiling; retain signed differences.
policy.runtime: Quote-free runtime forwards the actual current-flow receipt, including any residue of this flow on repeated tokens, never old inventory. There is no quote to compare at runtime.
policy.conservation: Non-principal route token inventory cannot decrease; at most one selected raw unit may remain. Native inventory remains exact. Repayment/min-profit/final simulation gates are not relaxed.
policy.cost: Per-hop input-debit protection adds one on-chain token balance read using the prior receipt balance as the before value. It adds no off-chain quote or balance RPC; execution-cost/performance acceptance remains pending.
